recipe.title: 1 · Intake Desk
recipe.body:
Capture incident location, caller, access constraints, urgency, people affected, and requested aid.

Output: validated incident ticket

recipe.title: 2 · Triage Cell
recipe.body:
Score life safety, isolation, medical risk, and time sensitivity. Assign priority, resource bundle, owner, and next review time.

Output: prioritized mission

recipe.title: 3 · Warehouse
recipe.body:
Confirm stock, reserve water/food/medical kits, stage loads by mission, and flag shortages or substitutions.

Output: load-ready inventory

recipe.title: 4 · Dispatch
recipe.body:
Match loads and teams to routes, vehicles, launch windows, and rendezvous points. Track en route, blocked, delivered, and returned.

Output: live movement plan

recipe.title: 5 · Shelters
recipe.body:
Report occupancy, remaining capacity, medical and accessibility needs, supply burn rate, and next resupply threshold.

Signal: capacity + demand

recipe.title: 6 · Field Teams
recipe.body:
Verify routes, assess communities, deliver aid, record unmet needs, and escalate hazards with location and time.

Signal: field conditions

recipe.title: 7 · Feedback Hub
recipe.body:
Merge shelter and field updates. Close completed tickets; return changed, blocked, or unmet missions for re-triage and rerouting.

Cadence: every 30 minutes

recipe.title: Live Coordination Rules
recipe.body: One owner per mission · Timestamp every status · Escalate life-safety blocks immediately · Reconcile inventory after every dispatch · Never close without delivery confirmation
